title: Plynth asset supports
description: The flat places on an asset where set dressing may put small props, measured by Blender at cleanup. The root is the list itself; asset info and the cleanup result refer to definitions/supports. Metres in the asset's own axes from its pivot (the bottom centre): x along its width, y along its depth with the front at minus y (as in asset.blend), z up.

clearance.description: The free height above the place.
